insights.summary: FY26 revenue rose 82% to ₹2,019 Cr and PAT to ₹140 Cr (7% margin), helped by gold bought outright with IPO money before prices rallied; volumes grew only ~15%. Management guided 30-40% volume and 60-70% value growth for FY27 (₹3,000-3,500 Cr) but a core PAT margin of only 3.5-4%, i.e. it does not expect last year's inventory gains to repeat. The Marol plant (4,000 kg a year) was about to start and Jaipur (1,200 kg) by September-October; inventory accounting moved from FIFO to weighted average with retrospective effect.
